一隻衰老的狗在爐火邊睡覺。
The interconnection of the two networks lets them share data.
兩個網路的相互連結讓它們能共享資料。
Scientists study the interconnection between sleep and health.
科學家研究睡眠與健康之間的相互關聯。
The idea that he could win without practice is laughable.
他不練習就想贏的想法實在可笑。
The excuse was so laughable that nobody believed it.
這個藉口荒謬到沒有人相信。

denver.zh: 丹佛（美國科羅拉多州首府）
ai: Denver is the capital of Colorado.
丹佛是科羅拉多州的首府。
Denver sits about one mile above sea level.
丹佛位在海拔約一英里的地方。
Someone in our town won the lottery jackpot.
我們鎮上有人中了樂透頭獎。
The jackpot grows bigger every week nobody wins.
每週沒人中獎，頭獎獎金就越滾越大。

jackpot.zh: 中大獎；大賺一筆（hit the jackpot）
ai: He hit the jackpot when his app became popular.
他的應用程式爆紅，讓他大賺了一筆。
We hit the jackpot with this cheap and great apartment.
找到這間便宜又棒的公寓，我們真是撿到寶了。
The study had dark wood paneling on every wall.
書房每面牆都鑲著深色木板。
They replaced the old paneling with fresh paint.
他們把舊的鑲板換成了新油漆。
He described the sunrise as a transcendental experience.
他形容日出是一次超凡的體驗。
Pi is a transcendental number that never ends.
圓周率是個永遠沒有盡頭的超越數。
She wore a silken scarf around her neck.
她脖子上圍著一條絲質圍巾。
The cat has soft, silken fur.
這隻貓有柔軟光滑的毛。
Medieval writers often called Muslim Arabs Saracens.
中世紀的作家常把穆斯林阿拉伯人稱作撒拉森人。
The knights in the story fought a Saracen army.
故事裡的騎士與撒拉森軍隊交戰。

dandy.zh: 花花公子；講究打扮的男人
ai: The young dandy spent hours choosing his tie.
那位年輕的紈褲子弟花了好幾個小時挑領帶。
In the old novel, the dandy is known for his fancy clothes.
在這部老小說裡，那位花花公子以華麗的服裝出名。
That's a dandy idea, so let's try it.
那是個很棒的主意，我們來試試吧。
We had a dandy time at the picnic.
我們在野餐時玩得很開心。

graded.zh: 評分；打分數（grade 的過去式）
ai: The teacher graded our tests over the weekend.
老師在週末批改了我們的考卷。
She graded each essay carefully.
她仔細地給每篇作文打分數。
The course has graded exercises from easy to hard.
這門課有由易到難的分級練習。
The path has a graded slope that is easy for beginners.
這條步道坡度平緩，適合初學者。
He lived in seclusion in a small cabin in the woods.
他隱居在森林裡的一間小木屋。
The writer sought seclusion to finish her book.
那位作家為了完成書稿而尋求清靜獨處。
The researchers created a typology of different learning styles.
研究人員建立了一套不同學習風格的分類系統。
This typology divides the buildings into three main groups.
這個類型學把建築分成三大類。

penzance.zh: 彭贊斯（英國康沃爾的海濱城鎮）
ai: Penzance is a town on the coast of Cornwall in England.
彭贊斯是英國康沃爾海岸的一座城鎮。
The train to Penzance runs along the sea for part of the way.
開往彭贊斯的火車有一段是沿著海邊行駛。
As a keen moviegoer, he sees a film every weekend.
身為熱愛看電影的人，他每個週末都會看一部電影。
Moviegoers lined up outside the theater for the new release.
電影觀眾在戲院外排隊等看新片。
The children waited with expectant faces for the gifts.
孩子們帶著期待的表情等待禮物。
Expectant mothers should get regular check-ups.
孕婦應該定期做產檢。
I can't outrun my brother, because he is a faster runner.
我跑不贏我哥哥，因為他跑得比較快。
The thief tried to outrun the police but was caught.
小偷想甩開警察，但還是被抓到了。
He had a ruddy face from working outdoors.
他因為在戶外工作，臉色紅潤。
The children came in with ruddy cheeks from the cold wind.
孩子們被冷風吹得雙頰紅通通地進了屋。
The enraged customer shouted at the manager.
憤怒的顧客對經理大吼。
She was enraged when she saw the damage to her car.
她看到車子受損時氣炸了。
The unfair ruling enraged the fans.
這個不公平的裁決激怒了球迷。
His rude reply enraged her even more.
他無禮的回答讓她更加憤怒。
Mountaineering requires good fitness and careful planning.
登山運動需要良好的體能和謹慎的計畫。
He took up mountaineering after his first trip to the Alps.
他第一次到阿爾卑斯山旅行後就迷上了登山。
Can I borrow your eraser to fix this mistake?
我可以借你的橡皮擦來改這個錯誤嗎？
The teacher used an eraser to clean the board.
老師用板擦把黑板擦乾淨。
He wore a black turtleneck under his jacket.
他在外套裡面穿了一件黑色高領衫。
A turtleneck keeps your neck warm in winter.
高領衫能在冬天讓脖子保暖。

released.zh: 釋放；發行（release 的過去式）
ai: The band released a new album last month.
這個樂團上個月發行了一張新專輯。
The police released the man after a few hours.
警方在幾小時後釋放了那名男子。
The harmonisation of rules makes trade between the countries easier.
規則的統一讓兩國之間的貿易更容易。
They called for the harmonisation of school hours across the region.
他們呼籲統一整個地區的上課時間。
A peddler walked from house to house selling needles and thread.
一位小販挨家挨戶地叫賣針線。
The peddler set up a cart near the station.
小販在車站附近擺了一輛攤車。
The campaign grew from a grassroots movement in small towns.
這場運動是從小鎮的草根行動發展起來的。
Grassroots groups helped clean up the river.
基層團體協助清理了那條河。

dumfries.zh: 敦夫里斯（蘇格蘭南部城鎮）
ai: Dumfries is a town in the south of Scotland.
敦夫里斯是蘇格蘭南部的一座城鎮。
We drove through Dumfries on our way to the coast.
我們前往海岸的途中經過了敦夫里斯。

tangy.zh: 酸味強烈的；味道濃烈的
ai: The salad has a tangy lemon dressing.
這份沙拉淋了酸味明顯的檸檬醬。
I like the tangy taste of fresh orange juice.
我喜歡鮮榨柳橙汁那股酸酸的味道。
This car runs only on unleaded gasoline.
這輛車只能加無鉛汽油。
Unleaded fuel is better for the environment.
無鉛燃料對環境比較好。

clipper.zh: 指甲剪；理髮剪（常用複數）
ai: I need a nail clipper to cut my fingernails.
我需要一把指甲剪來剪指甲。
The barber used a clipper to trim his hair short.
理髮師用電剪把他的頭髮剪短。
The clipper sailed across the ocean in record time.
這艘快速帆船以破紀錄的時間橫渡了海洋。
Tea was once carried from Asia by fast clipper ships.
茶葉過去曾由快速帆船從亞洲運出。
The contract and all documents attached thereto must be signed.
合約以及所有附於其後的文件都必須簽署。
Please read the rules and any changes thereto.
請閱讀規則及其任何修改內容。
The hotel lobby was opulent, with gold lights and marble floors.
旅館大廳富麗堂皇，有金色的燈和大理石地板。
They held an opulent party for their anniversary.
他們為紀念日辦了一場豪華的派對。
She wore a ring with a large sapphire.
她戴著一枚鑲有大顆藍寶石的戒指。
A sapphire is usually deep blue.
藍寶石通常是深藍色的。
The sapphire sea sparkled in the afternoon sun.
寶藍色的海在午後陽光下閃閃發亮。
She chose a sapphire dress for the evening.
她挑了一件寶藍色的洋裝參加晚宴。
The baby has a cute dimple in each cheek.
這個寶寶兩邊臉頰各有一個可愛的酒窩。
A dimple appears when she smiles.
她一笑就會出現酒窩。
The family hired a governess to teach the children at home.
這個家庭請了一位女家教在家教孩子們。
In the novel, a young governess arrives at a big old house.
在小說裡，一位年輕的女家教來到一棟老舊的大宅。
The nuns take a vow of chastity.
修女們發誓守貞。
In many old stories, chastity was seen as a great virtue.
在許多古老的故事裡，貞潔被視為一種美德。
The birds fly southward every autumn.
鳥兒每年秋天都會向南飛。
We drove southward along the coast.
我們沿著海岸向南開。
The southward journey took us three days.
向南的旅程花了我們三天。
A southward wind brought cooler air.
一陣向南吹的風帶來了較涼的空氣。
The Balkans lie in southeastern Europe.
巴爾幹半島位於東南歐。
We traveled through several countries in the Balkans last summer.
去年夏天我們遊覽了巴爾幹半島的幾個國家。
The singer received thunderous applause at the end.
歌手在結尾時獲得雷鳴般的掌聲。
A thunderous roar came from the crowd.
群眾發出震耳欲聾的吼聲。
A woodpecker was tapping on the tree outside my window.
一隻啄木鳥在我窗外的樹上啄個不停。
The woodpecker uses its strong beak to find insects in the bark.
啄木鳥用強壯的喙在樹皮裡找昆蟲。
The pharaoh was buried in a great pyramid.
法老被葬在一座宏偉的金字塔裡。
Tutankhamun was a young pharaoh of ancient Egypt.
圖坦卡門是古埃及一位年輕的法老。
The school hired a custodial staff to clean the building.
學校聘請了管理維護人員來清潔大樓。
The mother was given custodial care of the child.
母親取得了孩子的監護照顧權。

croak.zh: 發出呱呱聲；用沙啞的聲音說
ai: Frogs croak loudly by the pond at night.
青蛙夜裡在池塘邊大聲呱呱叫。
"Water, please," he croaked through a dry throat.
「請給我水。」他用乾啞的喉嚨說。
We heard the croak of a frog in the grass.
我們聽到草叢裡傳來青蛙的呱呱聲。
His voice was a weak croak after the long cold.
久病感冒後，他的聲音只剩微弱的沙啞聲。
The president's motorcade passed through the city center.
總統的車隊穿過市中心。
Police closed the road to let the motorcade go by.
警方封閉道路，讓車隊通過。
